section: Section 4.1 — Electronic Funds Transfer & Regulation E Unauthorized Dispute Handling
title: High-Value & Cross-Border Transfer Verification
summary: Transfers exceeding 2,500.00 in equivalent USD or exceeding 3.0x historical account average require enhanced behavioral telemetry validation before irrevocable settlement.
complianceRequirement: If normalized amount feature (f0) >= 0.45 and risk score >= 0.62, place transaction in FLAGGED_FRAUD or REVIEW_REQUIRED status pending customer step-up verification or analyst review within 24 hours.

section: Section 6.2 — Automated Card/Wallet Testing & Sliding-Window Velocity Controls
title: Rolling 60-Second Transaction Velocity Enforcement
summary: Accounts initiating more than 5 payment attempts within a rolling 60-second window indicate automated credential stuffing, script-driven balance draining, or replay abuse.
complianceRequirement: Enforce atomic sliding-window rate limiting via Redis ZSET. Transactions exceeding 5 attempts/60s must be blocked or elevated to critical risk review, and security audit logs must record the burst telemetry.

section: Section 7.4 — Impossible Travel, Cross-Border Corridor & IP Geolocation Mismatch
title: Geolocation Distance & Cross-Border Corridor Anomaly Policy
summary: Discrepancies between originating account jurisdiction, destination corridor, and IP geodesic distance exceeding 1,500 km correlate strongly with remote session hijacking.
complianceRequirement: When cross-border indicator (f1) > 0.50 or IP geodesic distance exceeds 1,500 km alongside low device trust (f6 > 0.40), analysts must verify session provenance and device fingerprint before releasing funds.

section: Section 8.1 — High-Risk Merchant Category Code (MCC) Controls
title: Digital Asset Exchanges, Offshore Gaming & Wire Remittance Counterparties
summary: Counterparties categorized under CRYPTO_EXCHANGE, GAMBLING, or OFFSHORE_WIRE carry elevated non-recoverable chargeback and money-mule typology risk.
complianceRequirement: Require corroborating account maturity (account age >= 90 days) and clean velocity history for high-risk MCC transfers; otherwise quarantine for Risk Analyst sign-off.

section: Section 9.3 — Account Takeover (ATO) & New-Device Off-Hours Draining
title: Untrusted Device & Nocturnal Window Draining Mitigation
summary: Transactions executed during off-hours UTC windows (00:00–05:00) from unrecognized devices (deviceTrustScore < 0.50) on newly provisioned or dormant accounts represent primary ATO vectors.
complianceRequirement: Preserve immutable evidence snapshot (8-D behavioral vector, top-K cosine similarity matches from fraud-behavior-vectors, and idempotency hash) for dispute arbitration.

section: Section 11.1 — Double-Entry Ledger Integrity & Idempotent Settlement
title: Zero-Sum Double-Entry Accounting & Non-Settlement of Declined/Flagged Transfers
summary: Every settled transfer (APPROVED) must atomically record one immutable DEBIT entry and one matching CREDIT entry of equal BigDecimal amount in the same currency.
complianceRequirement: Transfers marked FLAGGED_FRAUD, REVIEW_REQUIRED, DECLINED, or FAILED must not debit or credit customer wallet balances until explicitly approved, preserving zero-sum ledger reconciliation.
